written.headline: China drafts export controls on 23 AI technologies, pending adoption by year‑end
written.summary: China released draft rules on Oct. 16 that would add 23 AI‑related technologies, including large language models, agents, chip‑design tools and computing clusters, to its export‑control list. The rules would let overseas users access Chinese AI services online while requiring government approval for transfers of underlying models, data or expertise, and are expected to be adopted by the end of the year.

written.headline: OpenAI revises Model Spec around five core values
written.summary: OpenAI updated its public Model Spec, reorganizing it around five values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care. The update drops most style rules, renames the model as “GPT”, and acknowledges current models do not fully follow the new spec.

written.headline: Google says AI‑mode search generates less ad revenue per query, will add more ads worldwide
written.summary: Google disclosed that AI‑mode queries earn less revenue than traditional web searches because they show fewer and cheaper ads. To close the gap, the company announced it will roll out multi‑turn ads in AI‑mode across international markets.
